body:
AWAY-WINDOW SETUP (Joe is away, aida away set ~8h). Division of labor — please follow so we don't collide:

YOU are the PRODUCER only. Do NOT start your own chained drain / for-loop after BUG-1174 — a detached substrate driver (away-driver, PID 1912544) is already running and will drain every approved spec tagged batch:away-0916, one at a time, after BUG-1174 clears. Two drivers = single-drain-lock churn.

Your job: GROOM + QUEUE by tagging.
1. Decompose the in-progress epics (EPIC-62, EPIC-66, EPIC-67, EPIC-68, EPIC-69) into drain-safe child TASKs with clear acceptance criteria.
2. For each drain-safe child/spec: set status approved + add-tag batch:away-0916. That is ALL that's needed — the driver auto-picks up anything matching `aida list --status approved --tags batch:away-0916`.
3. PARK keystone for Joe's return, do NOT drain: STORY-1171 (merge-lease), STORY-1166 (GitLab Slice 3), and #1746 (CI-modifying). These are guided-for-a-reason.

Merge policy while away: merge-everything-that-passes-a-real-independent-review. Serialize merges (coordinate via mailbox — ping before a merge run). Independence rule HOLDS: never merge your own code; route those to me/a separate reviewer. Integrity gates stay hard (CI green, no concurrent merge). Not-convinced = doesn't pass = park.

Heartbeat discipline: keep it SUBSTRATE-driven. Do NOT idle-spin a mail-check loop narrating ticks — that is exactly what degenerated into the count/court junk earlier (filed TASK-1-135). Act on events, then stop.

Seeded already: STORY-1173 + TASK-1-136 are approved + tagged batch:away-0916.
